# ElementUI

The declarative UI library Element's screens are built with. Pinned from ElementUI `16f5934b5d77c198fa2233b58ab2d048419fb2b0` by `./scripts/run.sh elementui-sync <repository>`; don't edit these files by hand.

- `ElementUI.Core.dll`, `ElementUI.UGUI.dll`: shipped next to Element.dll in each version folder; other mods bind to them through Element.
- `analyzers/ElementUI.Analyzers.dll`: build-time rules (UI001…), not shipped.
